name: Bad People
overview: Scripture reveals that bad people are characterized by wickedness and harmful intentions, often plotting mischief and conflict in their hearts. The Psalms warn against associating with such individuals, describing their counsel as ungodly and their ways as destructive. Proverbs contrasts the righteous and the wicked, showing that righteousness preserves the upright while wickedness leads to downfall, and urges believers not to envy or desire the company of evil men. Even in matters of justice, as in Exodus, wrongdoing demands restitution, underscoring the seriousness of sin and its consequences.
